core_reading.why: Seminal framework that connects physical residual losses to forward and inverse PDE tasks.
core_reading.focus: Continuous-time PINN losses, data-driven discovery, and the inverse examples.

name: Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Neural function approximators trained with physical equation residuals and observational or boundary-condition constraints.
core_idea: Represent a solution field by a neural network and penalize ODE/PDE residuals alongside data and boundary conditions.
innovation: Makes differential-equation constraints part of network training, supporting both forward and selected inverse problems.
